name: alibaba/qwen4-max
description: Qwen4 Max is the flagship of Alibaba's Qwen 4 generation, released in November 2026. It is a multimodal reasoning model that takes text, images and video, with thinking on by default (reasoning_effort sets the depth), tool calling, web search and structured outputs, a 1M-token context and up to 393K output tokens shared by thinking and the answer. Alibaba positions it for coding, office work, frontend design and complex agent tasks, at a lower price than Qwen3.8 Max.
